description: The mirror of tests/jobs/refactor-reparent.json in the ODC lane (same kernel, same verb, IModelServices.MoveObject of the ODC Studio). The verb move with `into` CHANGES THE PARENT, through the two drag paths of the Studio. (1) Widget to another container, before a sibling: the native move of the platform (IModelServices.MoveObject) recreates the widget and the children in the new parent and relinks the consumers; the expression `RpDentro.Id + RpNeto.Id` still cites both, and the KEY changes (key.preserved false, keysChanged counts the subtree). (2) Screen to another UI flow: the button that navigates to it follows it, and the Description written earlier is still charged by the data contract, now on the new key. (3) Private block to another UI flow: the instance that uses it follows it. (4) Attribute to another entity, after a sibling. (5) Client action to a Client Actions folder and back to the root (`into: @espace`): only the Folder property changes, the key and the consumers stay the same (key.preserved true). Each move returns consumers before/relinked and the keys before/after; the final set of consumers is checked again after saving and reloading (refactorProof). The refusals (incompatible destination, consumer out of reach) are in tests/jobs-odc-negative/move-into-incompatible.json and tests/jobs-odc-negative/move-into-out-of-reach.json.
